content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: ‘Premises’ refers to the residential unit located at 456 Maple Avenue, Greenwood City.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_REASON_FOR_NOTICE
content_blocks.text: Tenant has failed to comply with the terms of the Lease Agreement by not paying rent for the past two months.

content_blocks.label: clause_3.1_ACTION_REQUIRED
content_blocks.text: Tenant is required to vacate the Premises within ten (10) days of receipt of this Notice.
